character_sheet: A small crested theropod: a body with hips and a tail behind, a neck to a head with a snout, a jaw beneath and the crest on top, two two-piece arms and two legs of thigh, shin, heel spur and foot (ModelCryolophosaurus.java:47-66; 20 parts on a 128x128 sheet, drawn at half size). It is a timid hunter: 10 HP, 3 damage, 1 armour, speed 0.25 (MobStats.CRYOLOPHOSAURUS, Cryolophosaurus.java:79-87). Every fifth tick it looks 9 blocks around for prey in sight - the big dinosaurs, ghosts, cave fishers, gamma metroids, butterflies, fireflies, mosquitoes, rock bases and creative players excepted (:117-136) - walks at it at 1.25 and bites within 2.2 blocks on timid 1-in-12-or-1-in-14 dice (:94-115, doHurtTarget :111); it retaliates when hit (:71) and, under a modern option, chases its attacker with a dinosaur melee goal whose attacking callback is a no-op (:57-67, :74-77 - it has no attacking flag). It floats (:55), panics (:56), wanders (:68) and spawns in darkness at night or below y 50 (:172-178). Read it as a nervous little raptor: a quick stride on rigid legs, the jaw working slowly all the time, the arms and tail carried still.
size_notes: Drawn at x0.5 of the rig (CryolophosaurusRenderer.java:20, 30) on a 128x128 sheet (ModelCryolophosaurus.java:173); the hitbox is 0.75 x 0.75 (ModEntities.java:78-79); shadow 0.75 x 0.5 (CryolophosaurusRenderer.java:23).

labels.jaw: lower jaw (hinged -72 deg; works open and shut)

groups.name: gait
groups.amplitude: rests -0.279 / +0.384 / -0.68 / 0 rad (thigh, shin, heel spur, foot), then pi x 0.25 = 0.785 rad (45 deg) x the walking speed at 1.3 x 0.75 - still (rests only) below the 0.1 threshold
groups.plain: the two legs stride in opposition, every part of a leg swinging together as one rigid unit
groups.math: a = limbSwingAmount > 0.1 ? cos(ageInTicks * 1.3 * 0.75) * pi * 0.25 * limbSwingAmount : 0; rightleg.xRot = -0.279 + a; rightleg2.xRot = 0.384 + a; rightleg3.xRot = -0.68 + a; rightleg4.xRot = a; leftleg* = the same rests - a
groups.omega_note: the classic phase is ageInTicks x 1.3 x 0.75 (wingspeed, ModelCryolophosaurus.java:24): the natural period is 2 pi / 0.975 = 6.4 ticks

groups.name: jaw
groups.amplitude: -1.15 rad rest, then pi x 0.1 = 0.314 rad (18 deg), at all times (no attacking branch)
groups.plain: the jaw works slowly open and shut around its hinge, whatever the creature is doing
groups.omega_note: the phase is ageInTicks x 0.28 (no wingspeed): the natural period is 2 pi / 0.28 = 22.4 ticks

behaviour: One gait rhythm on the legs (ModelCryolophosaurus.java:179-187): above a walking speed of 0.1 the cosine of the age x 1.3 x 0.75 (wingspeed, :24), x pi x 0.25, x the walking speed is added to every part of the right leg and subtracted from every part of the left - a 45-degree stride at full speed every 6.4 ticks; thigh, shin, heel spur and foot share one pivot and swing as one rigid unit around their rests. Below the threshold the legs snap to their rests.

The jaw works at all times (:188): -1.15 rad plus the cosine of the age x 0.28 x pi x 0.1 - 18 degrees every 22.4 ticks; there is no attacking branch and no attacking flag (the melee goal's callback is a no-op, Cryolophosaurus.java:74-77).
The body, neck, head, snout, crest, hips, tail and both arms never move; nothing reads the look (netHeadYaw unused), so the LookAtPlayerGoal (Cryolophosaurus.java:69) turns nothing visible.
The bite (doHurtTarget :111, within 2.2 blocks on timid dice) has no pose of its own; the renderer draws the whole rig at half size (CryolophosaurusRenderer.java:30).

wishlist: in `walk`: bend the legs - thigh, shin, heel spur and foot swing as one rigid unit (ModelCryolophosaurus.java:180-187); a knee and an ankle that lag the thigh, and a tail that counter-sways (static today), make a raptor's stride
in `attack`: a snap - the bite (Cryolophosaurus.java:111) has no pose today; a head-down lunge with the jaw closing on the impact frame
in `idle`: a head turn to the player (the LookAtPlayerGoal runs, Cryolophosaurus.java:69, but the model ignores netHeadYaw) and a twitch of the little arms
in `hurt`: a startled hop back - it is timid and panics (Cryolophosaurus.java:56)
formulas: `ModelCryolophosaurus.setupAnim` (ModelCryolophosaurus.java:177-189; orig ModelCryolophosaurus.java:165-174 in `render` (func_78088_a, :161-195; func_78087_a at :203-205 is a bare super call), wingspeed 0.75 from `new ModelCryolophosaurus(0.75f)` in orig ClientProxyOreSpawn.java:419): while the walking speed is above a tenth the leg swing is the cosine of the age in ticks times 1.3 times 0.75, times pi, times 0.25, times the walking speed, else 0; the right leg's four parts pitch by their rests -0.2792527, 0.384, -0.68 and 0 plus it and the left leg's by the same rests minus it; the jaw pitches by -1.15 plus the cosine of the age times 0.28, times pi, times 0.1, always. The walk position, the head angles and the entity's state play no part. The GeckoLib hook is the same (CryolophosaurusGeoReplacement.applyCustomAnimations).
